# hax.sys ![:inline](/images/twitter_verified.png) 

### Description

Intel Hardware Accelerated Execution Manager versions before 7.7.1 are affected by CVE-2022-21812. The signed 7.6.5, 7.6.5.3, and 7.7.0 builds tracked here expose the \\Device\\GHAX interface. Improper access control in the driver allows an authenticated local user to cross the user-to-kernel security boundary and elevate privileges.
- **UUID**: 9771266b-72e2-4ed3-ac14-1ac25dc5fb25
- **Created**: 2026-08-31
- **Author**: Michael Haag
- **Acknowledgement**: fluffycats31 | [@fluffycats31](https://twitter.com/@fluffycats31)

{{< button "https://github.com/magicsword-io/LOLDrivers/raw/main/drivers/01d673c8b80f4df91147e29e6cecefe5.bin" "Download" >}}

This download link contains the vulnerable driver!

{{< /tip >}}

{{< blockbanner "hax.sys" >}}
### Commands

```
sc.exe create IntelHAXM type= kernel binPath= C:\\windows\\temp\\hax.sys &amp;&amp; sc.exe start IntelHAXM
```


| Use Case | Privileges | Operating System | 
|:---- | ---- | ---- |
| Elevate privileges | User | Windows |
